    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    bool res = true;
    while (m > 0) {
        int r = m % w;
        if (r == 0 || r == 1) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (r == w - 1) {
            m++;

            break;

    }
    cout << (res ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;

}
